# scripts/PlayerUtils/CameraJuice.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/CameraJuice.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Cosmetic eye-local camera offsets, springs, shake, zoom, and traversal feedback.
setup() captures the camera and base FOV; update() writes camera.fov and
view offsets. The controller places the camera using view_transform().
Lean is supplied separately and remains active when intensity is zero.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

goes further.

### on_swing

```gdscript
func on_swing(side: float, power := false, kind: StringName = &"") -> void
```

[Source:166](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/CameraJuice.gd#L166)

A swing: the view goes with the cut. `side` +1 cuts to the left, -1 to
the right; `kind` is the swing ("overhead", "thrust"...); power is bigger.
The head is carried with the body's turn: a little turned, more moved.

### update

```gdscript
func update( delta: float, horizontal_speed: float, reference_speed: float, strafe: float, grounded: bool, crouched: bool, sprinting: bool, move_kind: int, move_s: float, windup := 0.0 ) -> void
```

[Source:278](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/CameraJuice.gd#L278)

Advances view effects in seconds from movement/state inputs and writes camera.fov.
move_s is normalized progress; move_kind uses presentation codes:
0 none, 1 mantle/pull-up, 2 vault, 3 lower, 4 leap (not TraversalMove.kind).
Call setup() first; locomotion_from_body replaces legacy bob/strafe/sprint effects.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `delta` | `float` | required |
| `horizontal_speed` | `float` | required |
| `reference_speed` | `float` | required |
| `strafe` | `float` | required |
| `grounded` | `bool` | required |
| `crouched` | `bool` | required |
| `sprinting` | `bool` | required |
| `move_kind` | `int` | required |
| `move_s` | `float` | required |
| `windup` | `inferred from default` | `0.0` |

Return type: `void`.
